_comment: A TEMPLATE, not data. The agent may write *.draft.json and never the fixture itself
(PRD §0.3 rule 2). Copy this to qa.json and replace every question, page and quote with
your own, read out of the real papers in fixtures/papers/.
Two questions are shown for p01 as a shape; the real set needs six per paper, thirty in all.
The quotes below are invented and match no paper — leaving them in would fail to locate.
fixtures/retrieval/README.md explains what makes a good question and a usable quote.

questions.question: What did most households give as the reason they had not adopted?
questions.quote: REPLACE ME — a verbatim sentence from p01 page 7 that answers the question above.

questions.question: How was the sample selected?
questions.quote: REPLACE ME — a verbatim sentence from p01's method section describing the sampling.
